name: theme-picker
title: Theme Picker
author: tony <tony@spaceman.sh>
description: A row of swatches that switches the accent colour theme at runtime: emerald, slate, azure, violet and amber. Each theme overrides the primary, ring and primary-ink tokens in light and dark, and the choice is stored and applied before first paint.

files.content:
/**
 * The colour themes the picker offers. Pass the same list to the
 * `ThemeProvider` as `colorThemes` so it can apply and persist the choice.
 *
 * Kept outside the client component so server files, such as the root layout,
 * can import the real array rather than a client reference.
 */
const colorThemes = ['emerald', 'slate', 'azure', 'violet', 'amber']

export { colorThemes }

docs: Pass the themes to the provider from @spaceman/theme-toggle: `<ThemeProvider colorThemes={colorThemes} defaultColorTheme="emerald">`, importing colorThemes from the installed themes.ts. The provider puts a `theme-<name>` class on <html>; the CSS this item adds maps each class to its accent tokens.
